provenance.publication_note: Publication export with metadata cleanup and shortened evidence excerpts. Query text, relevance IDs, evidence page numbers and document fingerprints are unchanged. Each quote/additional_quotes excerpt is an exact substring of the original frozen evidence. File byte hash differs from the source; original frozen data and evaluation remain unchanged.

human_review_scope: Reference answers and source locations manually reviewed; chunk relevance and exhaustiveness are AI-reviewed, not independently human-validated.

relevance_policy.positive: A readable chunk directly supports at least one substantive requested fact. Full and partial direct evidence are binary relevant; no arbitrary count cap.
relevance_policy.negative: Context-only, a different experiment, incomplete unidentifiable fragments, or evidence requiring additional unstated substitution/inference are excluded.
relevance_policy.corpus: All 130 original chunks remain candidates, including extraction-damaged chunks excluded from gold.
relevance_policy.metrics: Recall measures annotated chunk coverage, not answer completeness; repeated equivalent chunks and large gold sets can impose a Recall@K ceiling below 1.
relevance_policy.post_freeze: No tuning or label changes based on first-test rankings; any future correction uses a new version with an explicit exposure record.

cases.query: What degradation phenomenon do the authors observe when plain networks become deeper, and why do they say it is not simply overfitting?
cases.query_zh: 普通网络加深后出现什么退化现象？作者为什么认为它不只是过拟合？
cases.reference_answer_zh: 作者观察到，普通网络随深度增加，精度先饱和再下降；更深网络不仅验证/测试表现变差，训练误差本身也更高。作者据此将其视为优化困难，而不是仅仅学好了训练数据却不能泛化的典型过拟合。这个解释限定于该退化现象，不意味着深网络永远不会过拟合。

evidence.quote:
Figure 1. Training error (left) and test error (right) on CIFAR-10
with 20-layer and 56-layer “plain” networks. The deeper network
has higher training error, and thus test error.

depth increasing, accuracy gets saturated (which might be
unsurprising) and then degrades rapidly. Unexpectedly,
such degradation is not caused by overﬁtting , and adding
more layers to a suitably deep model leads to higher train-
ing error, as reported in [11, 42] and thoroughly veriﬁed by
our experiments.

The results in Table 2 show that the deeper 34-layer plain
net has higher validation error than the shallower 18-layer
plain net.

34-layer plain net has higher training error throughout the
whole training procedure, even though the solution space
of the 18-layer plain network is a subspace of that of the
34-layer one.

The deep plain nets suffer from increased depth,
and exhibit higher training error when going deeper.

cases.query: What three convolutional layers make up the bottleneck residual block, and what is the purpose of its 1×1 layers?
cases.query_zh: 瓶颈残差块由哪三层卷积构成？其中 1×1 卷积有什么作用？
cases.reference_answer_zh: 三层依次是 1×1、3×3、1×1 卷积。第一个 1×1 降低通道维度，第二个 1×1 在 3×3 之后升维/恢复维度，使中间较昂贵的 3×3 在较少通道上处理，从而节省计算。图 5 右侧示例为通道 256→64→64→256，不是空间宽高 256→64。

evidence.quote:
The three layers
are 1×1, 3×3, and 1×1 convolutions, where the 1×1 layers
are responsible for reducing and then increasing (restoring)
dimensions, leaving the 3×3 layer a bottleneck with smaller
input/output dimensions.

cases.query: How do the contracting and expansive paths of U-Net exchange fine-grained spatial information?
cases.query_zh: U-Net 的收缩路径和扩张路径如何传递精细的空间信息？
cases.reference_answer_zh: 把收缩路径中对应层的高分辨率特征图复制并裁剪，与扩张路径上采样后的特征图按通道拼接，再由后续卷积融合定位细节和上下文。原版使用无填充卷积，会损失边缘像素，因此需裁剪以匹配空间尺寸；拼接不是逐元素相加。

evidence.quote:
Every step in the expansive path consists of an upsampling of the
feature map followed by a 2x2 convolution (“up-convolution”) that halves the
number of feature channels, a concatenation with the correspondingly cropped
feature map from the contracting path, and two 3x3 convolutions, each fol-
lowed by a ReLU. The cropping is necessary due to the loss of border pixels in
every convolution.

cases.query: Why do the authors use an overlap-tile strategy, and how are missing image regions near a border handled?
cases.query_zh: 为什么使用重叠分块策略？图像边界附近缺失的区域如何处理？
cases.reference_answer_zh: 原版只预测具有完整输入上下文的有效区域，输入块比输出区域大。用相互重叠的输入块提供上下文，再拼接各块有效输出，可无缝分割大图，避免整图分辨率受GPU显存限制。图像边缘缺失的上下文通过镜像输入图像补足。

evidence.quote:
The network does not have any fully connected layers
and only uses the valid part of each convolution, i.e., the segmentation map only
contains the pixels, for which the full context is available in the input image.
This strategy allows the seamless segmentation of arbitrarily large images by an
overlap-tile strategy (see Figure 2). To predict the pixels in the border region
of the image, the missing context is extrapolated by mirroring the input image.
additional_quotes:
Prediction of the segmentation in
the yellow area, requires image data within the blue area as input. Missing input data
is extrapolated by mirroring

evidence.quote:

of the image, the missing context is extrapolated by mirroring the input image.
This tiling strategy is important to apply the network to large images, since
otherwise the resolution would be limited by the GPU memory.

cases.query: Why is elastic deformation used as data augmentation in the biomedical segmentation experiments?
cases.query_zh: 生物医学分割实验为什么使用弹性形变做数据增强？
cases.reference_answer_zh: 可用标注图像少，而组织形变是这类图像常见的变化。对已有训练样本模拟逼真的弹性形变，可以高效增加变化，使网络学会对形变更鲁棒，而不必在原始标注图像库中事先收集这些变化。

evidence.quote:
As for our tasks there is very little training data available, we use excessive
data augmentation by applying elastic deformations to the available training im-
ages. This allows the network to learn invariance to such deformations, without
the need to see these transformations in the annotated image corpus. This is
particularly important in biomedical segmentation, since deformation used to
be the most common variation in tissue and realistic deformations can be simu-
lated eﬃciently.

microscopical images we primarily need shift and rotation invariance as well as
robustness to deformations and gray value variations. Especially random elas-
tic deformations of the training samples seem to be the key concept to train
a segmentation network with very few annotated images.

cases.query: What warping error and Rand error does U-Net achieve on the electron-microscopy segmentation challenge?
cases.query_zh: U-Net 在电子显微图像分割挑战中取得的 warping error 和 Rand error 分别是多少？
cases.reference_answer_zh: 正文报告warping error为0.0003529，Rand error为0.0382；对输入的7个旋转版本进行预测平均，且没有进一步前处理或后处理。表1将warping error舍入为0.000353，与正文不是两组实验；两个值是误差数值，不是百分号写法。

evidence.quote:
The u-net (averaged over 7 rotated versions of the input data) achieves with-
out any further pre- or postprocessing a warping error of 0.0003529 (the new
best score, see Table 1) and a rand-error of 0.0382.

cases.query_zh: 生成器和判别器各起什么作用？
cases.reference_answer_zh: 生成器G将随机噪声映射为样本，学习数据分布，目标是生成能让判别器误判为真实的样本。判别器D估计输入来自真实数据而非生成器的概率，学习正确区分真实与生成样本。

In the proposed adversarial nets framework, the generative model is pitted against an adversary: a
discriminative model that learns to determine whether a sample is from the model distribution or the
data distribution. The generative model can be thought of as analogous to a team of counterfeiters,
trying to produce fake currency and use it without detection, while the discriminative model is
analogous to the police, trying to detect the counterfeit currency.

cases.query: In Algorithm 1, how many discriminator updates are used per generator update in the authors' experiments?
cases.query_zh: 实验中每更新一次生成器，判别器更新几次？
cases.reference_answer_zh: 1次，即k=1；每轮先更新判别器1步，再更新生成器1步。k是可选超参数，并非所有GAN都必须取1。

evidence.quote:
The number of
steps to apply to the discriminator, k, is a hyperparameter. We used k = 1, the least expensive option, in our
experiments.
